import sys

class Main:
    def main():
        input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
        n, m, l, r = map(int, input_data[:4])
        k = n * m
        len_ = r - l + 1
        mod = 998244353

        def power(x, y, p):
            res = 1
            x = x % p
            while y > 0:
                if y & 1:
                    res = (res * x) % p
                y >>= 1
                x = (x * x) % p
            return res

        if k % 2 == 1:
            print(power(len_, n * m, mod))
            return

        ans = ((power(len_, k, mod) + power(len_ % 2, k, mod)) * power(2, mod - 2, mod)) % mod
        print(ans)

    if __name__ == "__main__":
        Main.main()
